property_summary: transfer either reverts or returns true, and if it returns true then C.from and C.caddress remain unchanged and the function succeeds only when msg.sender equals the authorized address and _tos.length>0.

For any non-empty _tos array with matching v length and when caller is this test contract, c.transfer either reverts or returns true and if it returns true then c.from and c.caddress remain unchanged.
If transfer is called with non-empty _tos and matching lengths by this contract it either reverts or returns true and leaves c.from and c.caddress unchanged.
If transfer is called with a non-empty _tos whose length equals v.length by this test contract, then transfer either reverts or returns true.
When called with non-empty matching-length arrays by this contract, transfer either reverts or returns true (no other non-reverting return value).
If transfer(...) is called by the authorized from address and with non-empty _tos, it returns true and does not change C.from or C.caddress getters.
When called with non-empty _tos by this contract, transfer either reverts or returns true (it never returns false).
If transfer is called with _tos.length > 0 and msg.sender != c.from then the call must revert (i.e., this contract cannot successfully call transfer unless it is the authorized sender).
